messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired — P2: inference-eu-high-latency. Incident ID INC-20260316-01. Affected route: /v1/generate (eu-west-1).
alex.jensen: acked on PagerDuty, I'm on it. starting initial triage, pulling logs + metrics.
sam: seeing a spike in 5xx and request latency around 14:06 UTC, queue depth up on embedder pool.
alex.jensen: tailing runtime pods now, hit with intermittent `kv-cache` timeouts. running `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/eu-runtime -f | grep kvcache`.
maya.kim: oncall until 16:00 UTC, can take after you have a repro or need handoff @alex.jensen.
alex.jensen: thanks — reproducer is noisy; looks like cache eviction flood correlating with autoscaler oscillation. short snippet:
```
E 14:06:12 kvcache: eviction_rate=0.72 keys/sec
W 14:06:13 autoscaler: scaling down candidate->0 (10s window)
E 14:06:15 kvcache: backend timeout (conn reset)
```
pagerduty-bot: Acknowledged by alex.jensen (PAGERDUTY). Escalation paused.
alex.jensen: tentative mitigation: pin runtime to stable model variant and scale cache pool up 2 nodes. Applying change now.
julia: looping in customer comms. Drafting: "We're investigating increased inference latency in EU affecting some requests; no data loss; engineer actively mitigating. ETA ~30m." :thumbsup:
maya.kim: 10m update: scaled cache pool +2, started draining suspect nodes, error rate down from 17% -> 6%.
sam: confirming request latency tail has shortened, but p95 still elevated ~600ms vs 200ms baseline.
alex.jensen: rolling restart of evicting nodes completed, applied autoscaler smoothing (cooldown 120s -> 240s).
julia: posted status update to affected customers and support queue.
maya.kim: handoff to me for monitoring — alex, if you want to transfer PD ownership, please do.
alex.jensen: handing off. transferring PD ack to maya.kim now.
pagerduty-bot: Ownership changed: acknowledged by maya.kim. Auto-escalation timers reset.
maya.kim: taking over. I'll keep eye for recurrence and coordinate postmortem. next update 15m.
15m later...
maya.kim: 15m update: error rate stabilized at 1.2%, p95 latency back to ~230ms. autoscaler smoothing reduced oscillations. marking incident as resolved in 10m if stable.
sam: verified no customer-facing retries in last 12m, no new PD pages.
julia: updating customer comms: "Issue mitigated; full recovery in progress; detailed postmortem to follow." :white_check_mark:
maya.kim: resolved and closed PD incident INC-20260316-01. will open follow-up ticket for k-v cache eviction guardrails and autoscaler tuning.
alex.jensen: thanks everyone — creating postmortem draft and linking diagnostics.
julia: closing support loop with customers now.
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260316-01 marked resolved by maya.kim at 2745621410.
sam: closing thread, will add monitoring alert to warn on eviction spikes earlier.
